**Finding: Deviation (medium) — Article II.IV(b) audit right, ¶p0073**

**What the document does:** Licensee must permit an independent, mutually selected CPA/Audit Professional to audit its accounting records "within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor." There is no cap on frequency, no advance-notice requirement (the 30 days is a compliance deadline, not notice), no business-hours or off-site limitation, no auditor confidentiality undertaking.

**What is already acceptable:** the auditor is independent and mutually selected, and ¶p0064 puts audit cost on Licensor unless a discrepancy greater than 5% is found — that matches our preferred cost position, so no edit there. No remote/system-access language exists today, but nothing forecloses it either.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** amended ¶p0073 to require that any audit occur no more than once in any twelve-month period, during normal business hours, on not less than 30 days' prior written notice, off-site wherever practicable, with no direct or remote access to our systems, networks or premises, and with the auditor first executing confidentiality undertakings in our favor.

**Fallback if pushed:** 15 days' notice instead of 30, retaining the annual cap and the no-system-access limit.
